messages:
alex_g: heads up — we just got a DSAR (subject request) for user email user+privacy@example.com at 11:32. simultaneously a low-sev vuln was triaged that touches the embeddings service. can we sync on whether to trigger a retention freeze or proceed with normal erasure?
mira_s: want to see scope first — is the DSAR for account-level data or specific embeddings?
alex_g: request says "all personal data" and references chat transcripts + generated embeddings. unclear on stored artifact ids. legal asked for proof-of-request before we action.
sam_ops: if there's an active vuln we should probably put a forensic hold on relevant buckets and snapshots until triage completes. otherwise deletion might remove evidence. :warning:
ida_legal: correct — legal prefers a short hold window for forensic collection if risk exists. we need to document chain-of-custody and send signer verification checklist to the requester. I'll draft.
kevin_sec: +1 on hold. also need to ensure RBAC changes don't break evidence capture. which service account owns the embeddings deletion job?
alex_g: deletion job is run by svc-emb-delete@prod. it assumes kms:key-emb-v1 for decrypt and uses archival-snapshots.
sam_ops: logs look okay but there are gaps around 02:00 deployments. snippet from audit logs: 
```
2026-02-19T02:03:12Z svc-emb-delete START job_id=abc123 target=embeddings/user+privacy@eu1
2026-02-19T02:03:15Z svc-emb-delete CALL kms:Decrypt key=kms://projects/rw/keys/key-emb-v1 user=svc-emb-delete
2026-02-19T02:03:16Z ERROR storage:read timeout snapshot=snap-20260218-01
```
kevin_sec: that ERROR worries me. could be transient, could be a partial delete leaving orphaned indexes. we need a validated registry of artifact ids before any erasure.
mira_s: how fast can we snapshot and export the artifact list to legal? is there an automated listing we can run?
sam_ops: yes — run `tools/embeddings/export_ids --filter email=user+privacy@example.com --format=json` but it'll pick up current state only. if we freeze deletion now we should also lock manifests to avoid concurrent partial deletes.
alex_g: propose flow: 1) Immediately create a short-term hold: tag snapshots + storage objects with `legal_hold=dsar-2490012345` and set retention exception for 72h. 2) Run artifact export and forensics collection. 3) Legal verifies requester; 4) If verified and no vuln-risk, proceed with deletion rollback/verify. Does that sound ok?
ida_legal: fine. I need exported manifest and chain-of-custody steps in 6 hours. I'll confirm identity verification template.
kevin_sec: RBAC item — we should add temporary allow to `svc-emb-delete` for `storage.list_snapshots` and `kms:Decrypt` scoped to `arn:...:key-emb-v1` so audits show explicit grant. then remove grant after collection. Also enable verbose audit logging for kms key for the hold duration.
sam_ops: I can add a short-lived principal grant via terraform with a 3-day TTL. will post PR link.
sre-bot: Deploy queued: terraform-plan #4587 by sam_ops for temp-rbac-2490012345 (will auto-remove in 72h).
alex_g: for the deletion verification step we'll need to run deterministic hash checks and provide proof of removal: `sha256sum` of affected objects before delete and a signed deletion record.
mira_s: also confirm embedding vectors are actually immutable copies in the vector DB. some upstream pipelines replicate embeddings to cache layers — we must enumerate caches.
kevin_sec: check KMS rotation state too. if key rotates mid-flow we lose ability to decrypt prior snapshots — so freeze rotation for that key until we've exported. open a KMS pause ticket if needed.
ida_legal: filing DSAR response timeline: 30 days standard but we'll request a 15-day extension citing necessary forensics. pls confirm within 4 hours.
sam_ops: PR: https://rwd.internal/infra/pulls/4587 — applies tag + grant + export job: `infra/hold_dsar_2490012345.tf`
alex_g: action items recap: sam: apply hold & export, kevin: enable verbose KMS/audit and pause rotation if required, mira: enumerate caches, ida: start requester verification and extension request to regulator, alex: prepare deletion verification plan.
kevin_sec: noted. will also snapshot KMS usage logs to a secure S3 bucket `secure-logs/forensics/2490012345` with restricted ACLs.
sre-bot: terraform apply completed: hold tags created, temp RBAC granted, export job scheduled. run id `run-2490012345-01`
alex_g: thanks. once export is in hand let's do a short sync. keep chatter here brief — escalate to #incidents if we see evidence of compromise.
ida_legal: I'll post verification checklist in 30m. :writing_hand:
mira_s: ping when caches list done, I'm starting now.
sam_ops: export finished, manifest attached to PR (s3://secure-logs/forensics/2490012345/manifest.json). partials noted for snapshot snap-20260218-01. opening an investigation ticket.
kevin_sec: investigation note: snapshot read-timeouts correlated with a noisy autoscaling event on eu1-gpu-pool — tracking with infra. if deletion had started it may have retried and logged partial deletions. we must validate IDs in manifest vs storage indexes.
alex_g: good work. we'll reconvene in 2 hours after initial triage. thanks all. :thumbsup:
